news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 14% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.7x net interest cover). news.title: G.S. Auto International Limited Announces Management Changes, February 7, 2026
news.body: G S Auto International Limited approved the appointment of Ms. Jasmine Kaur, Company Secretary (holding Membership No. A79557) as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from February 7, 2026. Ms. Jasmine Kaur is a Member of ICSI (Membership No.: A79557) and holds Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from University of Delhi. The Board of Directors noted the cessation of Mr. Harkirat Singh Ryait, Executive Director (DIN: 07275740) as the Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from February 7, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these changes in their meeting held on February 7, 2026.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.10 (vs ₹0.34 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.10 (up from ₹0.34 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹397.1m (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹7.35m (up 49% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.9% (up from 1.4% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 108% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 27% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: G.S. Auto International Limited Announces Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Changes
news.body:
G.S. Auto International Limited announced that Sandeep, has tendered his resignation with effect from closure of Business hours on 21 January, 2026 from the position of Company Secretary & Compliance Officer for pursuing opportunities outside the organization.
This is also to inform that Mr. Harkirat Singh Ryait, Executive Director has been appointed as Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from 22 January, 2026 pursuant to Regulation 6(1) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Appointment of Mr. Harkirat Singh Ryait as Compliance Officer under the category of Key Managerial Personnel of the Company 22 January, 2026, consequent to the resignation of Mr. Sandeep.

news.title: G S Auto International Limited Announces Resignation Of Independent Director Sehijpal Singh Khangura, Effective January 14, 2026
news.body: G S Auto International Limited announced that Mr. Sehijpal Singh Khangura (DIN: 09057746) has tendered his resignation from the position of Independent Director of the Company with effect from January 14, 2026, due to his personal and professional commitments. The Company has received and accepted his resignation on January 19, 2026 and he has been relieved from his responsibilities. The company is required to file the necessary forms with the Registrar of Companies as per the Companies Act, 2013.
